test_results.steps:
1. Launch Android app
2. Verify BIOPATCH AI title and hero branding text
test_results.expected: App launches cleanly with branding and explore button
test_results.actual: App launched successfully with BioPatch AI branding and title.

test_results.steps:
1. Inspect app loading indicator
2. Verify session readiness check
test_results.expected: Splash screen initializes and checks saved user session token
test_results.actual: Splash/loading screen initialized and completed session readiness check.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Login screen
2. Inspect Email, Password, and Sign In button fields
test_results.expected: Login inputs and buttons rendered and active
test_results.actual: Login screen form fields, branding header, and authentication buttons rendered.

test_results.steps:
1. Tap 'Sign In' without filling inputs
2. Observe validation notice
test_results.expected: Form validation requires email and password
test_results.actual: Form validation correctly required email and password fields before submission.

test_results.steps:
1. Enter invalid email and password
2. Tap 'Sign In'
test_results.expected: Error notice alerts user of invalid credentials
test_results.actual: Invalid login credentials handled with onscreen error alert.

test_results.steps:
1. Enter demo credentials
2. Tap 'Sign In'
test_results.expected: User authenticated and redirected to Dashboard
test_results.actual: Demo researcher authenticated successfully and navigated to workspace dashboard.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Register screen
2. Inspect Name, Email, Role, Password fields
test_results.expected: Registration form fields rendered correctly
test_results.actual: Registration screen form fields (Name, Email, Role, Passwords) rendered correctly.

test_results.steps:
1. Enter non-matching passwords
2. Submit registration form
test_results.expected: Validation error alerts passwords do not match
test_results.actual: Registration password mismatch validation triggered error message as expected.

test_results.steps:
1. Enter unique user profile details
2. Submit registration form
test_results.expected: User account created and auto-logged in to workspace
test_results.actual: User registration succeeded and automatically navigated to research workspace.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Forgot Password
2. Enter registered email
3. Tap 'Send Reset Link'
test_results.expected: Confirmation confirms password reset email dispatched
test_results.actual: Forgot password reset link request submitted successfully.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Dashboard
2. Inspect stat summary cards and system status
test_results.expected: Total Simulations, Avg Release, Score stat cards displayed
test_results.actual: Dashboard metric summary cards and system status indicators rendered.

test_results.steps:
1. Inspect Dashboard chart container
2. Verify dissolution curve rendering
test_results.expected: FlChart graphical dissolution curve component rendered
test_results.actual: FlChart / Canvas graphical dissolution curve component rendered properly.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Simulator
2. Inspect formulation selects and parameter sliders
test_results.expected: All formulation controls and sliders accessible
test_results.actual: Simulator form controls (drug/polymer selectors, 0 parameter sliders) rendered.

test_results.steps:
1. Tap 'RUN KINETICS SIMULATION'
2. Observe calculation progress
test_results.expected: Dissolution release curve and risk metrics generated
test_results.actual: Kinetics dissolution solver executed and output release metrics rendered.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to AI Prediction
2. Inspect Random Forest R² accuracy metrics
test_results.expected: AI prediction parameters and regression metrics displayed
test_results.actual: AI Prediction module loaded with Random Forest ML regression metrics.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Release Monitor
2. Inspect live sensor controls and telemetry status
test_results.expected: Biological sensor parameters (pH, temp, moisture) displayed
test_results.actual: Release Monitor screen loaded with real-time biological sensor status.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Drug Database
2. Inspect drug cards and search filtering
test_results.expected: Drug catalog cards rendered and searchable
test_results.actual: Drug Library database catalog loaded with active compound profiles.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Polymer Registry
2. Inspect biopolymer matrix cards (PLA, Alginate, Chitosan)
test_results.expected: Polymer cards and swelling/degradation details rendered
test_results.actual: Polymer Library matrix catalog loaded with biopolymer matrix details.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Simulation History
2. Inspect historical run archives
test_results.expected: Past simulation execution runs listed
test_results.actual: Simulation History archive loaded with past execution records.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to Pre-clinical Reports
2. Inspect compiled reports
test_results.expected: Pre-clinical reports archive loaded
test_results.actual: Pre-clinical Reports archives loaded successfully.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to System Settings
2. Inspect profile information inputs and save preferences
test_results.expected: User profile & settings form rendered
test_results.actual: User Profile & System Settings configuration screen loaded.

test_results.steps:
1. Open Navigation Drawer menu
2. Tap target route link
test_results.expected: Navigation drawer seamlessly routes between workspace screens
test_results.actual: Navigation drawer seamlessly routed user to DRUG DATABASE screen.

test_results.steps:
1. Navigate to sub-screen
2. Trigger Android back button
test_results.expected: Route stack pops correctly to previous screen
test_results.actual: Android back button press successfully popped current route stack.

test_results.steps:
1. Leave required inputs empty
2. Tap submit action
test_results.expected: Form validation blocks empty submission
test_results.actual: Required field validation blocked empty form submission.

test_results.test_name: Invalid Input Bounds & Parameter Range Handling
test_results.steps:
1. Adjust parameter sliders to min/max bounds
2. Observe parameter readout
test_results.expected: Sliders and numeric fields enforce valid parameter ranges
test_results.actual: Parameter sliders and numeric inputs successfully enforced valid boundaries.

test_results.steps:
1. Verify network health check logic
2. Observe offline demo fallback
test_results.expected: App gracefully handles API network state and falls back smoothly
test_results.actual: API network health verification handled with offline fallback.

test_results.test_name: Session Behavior & Sign Out Token Clearance
test_results.steps:
1. Tap 'SIGN OUT SESSION'
2. Verify storage cleared and redirect to Home/Login
test_results.expected: User session terminated and token cleared
test_results.actual: Session terminated and user token cleared upon sign out.
